purpose: System-One task classifier rubric and calibration cases. Read only by the router scorer (route_judge.py), never by parent agents.

route_definitions.computer_use: Operate a desktop or browser GUI via screenshots, mouse, and keyboard (e.g. click buttons, inspect live UI windows).
route_definitions.visual_analysis: Inspect images, screenshots, charts, or design frames without writing application code.
route_definitions.frontend_implementation: Build, style, or modify web/desktop UI components, layouts, CSS, or frontend state.
route_definitions.tool_execution: Run existing CLI commands, scripts, checklists, deployments, or read-only operational probes without designing new code.
route_definitions.bounded_bulk_work: Mechanical, repetitive edits or batch processing across many files/items with a uniform rule.
route_definitions.debug_review: Diagnose a bug, regression, test failure, or perform code/security review with concrete verification.
route_definitions.general_implementation: Write or refactor backend, library, or full-stack production code and tests in a repository.
route_definitions.self_contained_code: Write standalone code, algorithms, or unit-tested modules that do not depend on local machine state or secrets.
route_definitions.exploration_analysis: Explore a repository, trace architecture, or analyze logs and datasets to answer an investigative question.
route_definitions.research_packet: Execute a quantitative experiment, backtest, data pipeline, or statistical analysis packet and report metrics.
route_definitions.web_research: Search and synthesize public documentation, papers, benchmarks, or web sources.
route_definitions.text_in_text_out: Draft, translate, summarize, or rewrite self-contained text or documentation from provided inputs.
route_definitions.dot_execution: Self-contained remote sandbox computation or file transformation explicitly suited for an isolated container.
route_definitions.complex_build_plan: Design a multi-phase system architecture or implementation specification before coding begins.
route_definitions.direction_reasoning: High-stakes strategic, mathematical, or architectural tradeoff reasoning (advisor consultation).

dimension_rubric.scope_rule: Score functional work, not brief length or formatting. Multi-section Markdown, authorization quotes, communication rules and file lists do not raise any dimension.
dimension_rubric.boilerplate_paths: Role/rule docs (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/roles/*.md, skill/README/runbook docs), prior reports/reviews read as input, receipt/output/log/scratch paths and a target module's paired unit-test file never inflate context_scale or reasoning_depth.
dimension_rubric.read_only_review: Independent code review, security/invariant audit or diff verification: work_kind debug_review, code_complexity 0, hallucination_risk 3, divergence 1, reasoning_depth 2 (3 only for deep cross-module concurrency or architectural-invariant audits). Context is 1 for a localized diff, 2 for several coupled modules.
dimension_rubric.runbook_execution: Following documented build/deploy/release runbooks, operational health checks or automated test/benchmark suites without designing new code: work_kind tool_execution, reasoning_depth 1, code_complexity 0, context_scale 1; error_cost 3 when touching production.
dimension_rubric.diagnosis: Unknown root cause with multiple candidate hypotheses to test (latency/CPU/memory regression, intermittent failure, rendering glitch): divergence 2; code_complexity 0 for read-only diagnosis, 2 for diagnosing and fixing a module with tests.
dimension_rubric.research_packet: Running a defined quantitative experiment, benchmark suite, simulation, statistical evaluation or backtest pipeline and reporting metrics: work_kind research_packet, reasoning_depth 2, code_complexity 1, context_scale 2, divergence 1, hallucination_risk 3. Mere execution of documented commands without interpreting experimental results is tool_execution.
dimension_rubric.orchestration: Multi-stage coordinator or lead-session handoff dispatching workers and verifying cross-task deliverables: reasoning_depth 3, context_scale 3, divergence 1; code_complexity 0 for coordination/review alone, 2 when also implementing integration code.
